title: run_log
description: One row per query per run. Every run of the same arms must contain the same queries.

run_id.description: Repeat run name, e.g. A. Repeats of the same arms give the noise floor.

query.description: The exact text sent to retrieval.

arms.description: Fixes switched on for this row; empty for the baseline.

retrieved.description: Documents handed to the LLM, best first.

shown_ids.description: Ids of the passages of this document the LLM actually saw, in prompt order.

cited_doc_ids.description: Documents the answer cites; empty if none.
